id: \bYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
en: \bYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
it: \bSembri stanco. Perché non ti riposi un po'?

id: \bOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \bOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \bOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \rCynthia: You made it \PN. Your friend is waiting in the back room.
en: \rCynthia: You made it \PN. Your friend is waiting in the back room.
it: \rCamilla: Ce l'hai fatta, \PN. Il tuo amico ti aspetta nella stanza sul retro.

id: \rCynthia: The tournament should be starting soon.
en: \rCynthia: The tournament should be starting soon.
it: \rCamilla: Il torneo dovrebbe cominciare a breve.

id: \rCynthia: I'm surprised you took on Team Rocket like that. I'm impressed.
en: \rCynthia: I'm surprised you took on Team Rocket like that. I'm impressed.
it: \rCamilla: Mi ha sorpreso come hai affrontato il Team Rocket. Sono colpita.

id: \rDawn: \PN! It's so good to see you again. I've been traveling through Johto and decided to visit Unova for a while.
en: \rDawn: \PN! It's so good to see you again. I've been traveling through Johto and decided to visit Unova for a while.
it: \rLucinda: \PN! Che bello rivederti! Ho viaggiato per Johto e ho deciso di fare un salto a Unima per un po'.

id: \rI'm also entering the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup. Let's have a practice round to warm us up.
en: \rI'm also entering the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup. Let's have a practice round to warm us up.
it: \rAnch'io partecipo alla Coppa Junior del Pokémon World Tournament. Facciamo una lotta di prova per scaldarci.

id: \rDawn: I hope we meet up when it starts. It would be an epic showdown.
en: \rDawn: I hope we meet up when it starts. It would be an epic showdown.
it: \rLucinda: Spero che ci incontreremo quando inizia. Sarebbe una sfida epica.
